theorems.name: Submission.bv_exists_subseq_tendstoLocallyInL1On
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ k, LocallyIntegrableOn (u k) U volume) → (∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ U → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ j ∈ F, (∫⁻ x in Q, ‖u k x - u j x‖ₑ) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (v : Rn n → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ LocallyIntegrableOn v U volume ∧ Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On (fun k ↦ u (ψ k)) v U atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
